newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Chile's Enersis eyes Brazil power sector.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Enersis eyes Brazil power sector.

text.p: Chile's Enersis, which already has a toehold in Brazil's power sector, plans to expand its presence by taking part in upcoming selloffs of state-owned power firms, a company official said.
"We are interested in participating in the sales of practically all energy generation and distribution companies in Brazil," Eneris Research and Development Manager Arsenio Molina Alcade said.
Molina, speaking at an energy conference here, said Enersis was particularly interested in the privatization of Bahia state power firm Coelba and all of Sao Paulo state's electrical companies.
But he ruled out any participation in the sale of Minas Gerais power firm Cemig, which is scheduled to go to the auction block on Wednesday.
Molina said Enersis, Chile's largest power company, has confidence in the Brazilian economy and the growth outlook for the nation's power sector.
Last year Enersis, through its distribution subsidiary Chilectra, led a group that bought 42 percent of Rio de Janeiro state company Cerj.
Enersis also has holdings in Argentina, Colombia and Peru. Molina said the firm was no longer interested in Peru's power sector because the remaining power firms were too small.
He added that Chile's power sector was expected to grow nine percent this year.
